date_note: Abnormal access confirmed 11 Nov; the Federation posted its breach notice on 14 Nov, the date used here.
title: Korea Federation of SMEs says third parties may have looked up customer data on its Yellow Umbrella site
org: Korea Federation of Small and Medium Business (Kbiz)
impact: Signs that third parties viewed customer records; no count of affected customers given.
summary: MTN reports the Federation of SMEs confirmed abnormal outside access to its Yellow Umbrella mutual-aid website on 11 November and signs that customer data was looked up. Items that may have been seen: name, first seven digits of the resident registration number, mobile number, home address and phone, email and marketing consent. It blocked the attacking IPs, reported to KISA and texted suspected customers. No count was given.
plain: A Korean small-business mutual-aid scheme says outsiders may have looked up members' names, addresses and part of their ID numbers.
exec: A membership site of a large business body exposed personal data, which fuels targeted phishing.
action: Members should ignore calls or texts asking for money, loans or login changes, and use the site's lookup to see if their data was viewed.
